tradeview.config.title: TradeView settings
tradeview.config.autoTrade.hint: Click, then press one key or hold two keys together. Release the keys to save. Escape clears the binding. Press the hotkey again to stop trading.
tradeview.config.updateCheck.hint: Checks for updates when you first enter singleplayer after starting the game. Changes apply to the next game session. Turning this off also suppresses pending notifications.
tradeview.config.unlimitedTrades.hint: Removes trade stock limits for all players on this server. Ingredients are still required. Turning this off restores the original limits.
tradeview.config.unlimitedTrades.require: Unlimited Trades requires TradeView 1.0.10 or newer on the server.
Only the singleplayer host or a server operator can change this setting.
tradeview.reroll.tooltip:
Reroll trades (%s)
Only available until someone trades with this villager.
tradeview.config.reroll.hint: Shows the ↻ button in the trading screen to reroll the trades of a villager nobody has traded with yet. Turning it off also disables the hotkey (%s, configurable under Options → Controls).
tradeview.find.pending: Open a librarian's trading screen within 60 seconds to search for %s. Cancel with /tradepreview find stop.
tradeview.find.timeout: Search for %s cancelled – no trading screen was opened within 60 seconds.
tradeview.find.closed: Search for %s cancelled – the trading screen was closed.
tradeview.find.notTradeable: Note: %s is normally not sold by villagers.
tradeview.find.unavailable: Searching requires TradeView on the server.
tradeview.find.found.current: Found %s after %s rerolls – in the current trades.
tradeview.find.found.preview: Found %s after %s rerolls – in the preview (%s).
tradeview.find.notRerollable: Not found – this villager cannot be rerolled because it has already been traded with.
tradeview.find.noBooks: This villager offered no enchanted books after %s rerolls – search stopped.
tradeview.find.neverOffered: %s never appeared for this villager in %s rerolls – it probably doesn't sell it at all (e.g. biome-specific trades with the Villager Trade Rebalance). Search stopped.
tradeview.find.limit: %s was not found after %s rerolls – search stopped.
